documents.title: Press Release - CPCL Financial Performance For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its highest-ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT for FY26, representing 112% of installed capacity, and 2.93 MMT in Q4 FY26. Average gross refining margin for FY26 stood at $9.28 per barrel compared to $4.22 per barrel in FY25, while Q4 FY26 GRM reached $13.75 per barrel. The company recommended a total dividend of INR 62 per share for FY26, comprising an interim dividend of INR 8 and a final dividend of INR 54. CPCL is undertaking major growth initiatives, including a INR 1,600 crore LOBS expansion and a INR 400 crore retail outlet project over the next 2 to 3 years. During Q4 FY25, Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) achieved a crude throughput of 2.974 MMT, equivalent to 113% of its installed capacity.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects routine annual maintenance capex to be around INR 500 crores every year.
guidance.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects significant commissioning from its retail outlet initiative in FY27.
guidance.quote: And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

guidance.claim: CPCL projects normal maintenance CAPEX to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year for the next two years.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

guidance.claim: Operational crude throughput in FY26 is expected to be higher than in FY25 due to a lower shutdown impact.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

demand_outlook.claim: Niche products constitute 7% to 8% of CPCL's product volume and contribute around 15% to its margins.
demand_outlook.quote: About 7% to 8% constitutes these kinds of niche products. And this 7%–8% is currently contributing around 15% of my margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Southern market MS demand faces a shortfall where production is less than demand by around 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: MS demand growth in the southern market is projected at 4% to 5% compared to 6% nationally.
demand_outlook.quote: Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%.

demand_outlook.claim: HSD demand growth in the southern market is forecasted at 3% compared to 2.5% nationally.
demand_outlook.quote: HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL incurred capex of INR 856 crores in FY26 compared to INR 673 crores in FY25.
capex_expansion.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: Project execution for CPCL's Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project has started with an estimated outlay of INR 1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL's retail outlet project involving 300 licenses requires a capex of INR 400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The combined INR 2,000 crore capex for the LOBS and retail outlet projects will take place over 2 to 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL has doubled its Hexane production capacity from 30 to 60.
capex_expansion.quote: It was 30, now the capacity is 60.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL's new LOBS unit will add 250 KTPA of Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores on CAPEX during FY24-25.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery Basin Refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity structure between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL has full custody of 1,200 acres of land required for the Cauvery Basin Refinery project.
capex_expansion.quote: The most important updates with respect to the project is now we have full custody of the land. So, about 600 acres, which was already with CPCL and another 600 acres, which was acquired in the process, both is in our possession

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL is in an advanced approval stage for a project upgrading Naphtha and HSD to LOBS Group-II and III.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS i.e. Lube Oil Based Stock, Group- II and III, the proposal is at a very advanced stage on approval, wherein NAPHTHA and HSD will be upgraded to LOBS Group-II and III.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL has installed a 1.04 MW capacity solar system across plant area buildings.
capex_expansion.quote: 1.04 MW capacity of Ground Mounted and Roof top solar system on plant area buildings

margins_costs.claim: Average gross refining margin for FY26 stood at $9.28 per barrel compared to $4.22 per barrel in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: Average gross refining margin for the period April to March '26 is US$9.28 per barrel (April to March 2025: US$ 4.22 per barrel).

margins_costs.claim: CPCL achieved a core GRM of $10.3 per barrel in Q4 FY26.
CPCL processed 52% high sulphur crude in FY26, sourcing 48% low sulphur crude as it was cheaper.
margins_costs.quote: So we — instead of 30%, we sourced 48% LS because we found LS to be cheaper than HS.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year GRM for FY25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL recorded a GRM of $6.22 per barrel in Q4 FY25 compared to the Singapore benchmark of $3.1 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel. Again, if I compare the previous year same quarter, it was $7.7 per barrel, but if I compare it to Singapore benchmark, which was only $3.1 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY25 inventory gain was $0.66 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel and loss for the full year FY25 dropped to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: The average discount on opportunity crude during FY25 was between $1.5 and $2 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: Last year, that is the Financial Year’24-25, the average was around $1.5-$2.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL reported GRM of $11.91 per barrel in FY 2022-23, $8.64 per barrel in FY 2023-24, and $3.40 per barrel in 9M FY 2024-25.
Core GRM stood at $12.94 per barrel in FY 2022-23, $8.21 per barrel in FY 2023-24, and $3.75 per barrel in 9M FY 2024-25.
Net operating expenditure was Rs 1,085 crore in FY 2022-23, Rs 1,215 crore in FY 2023-24, and Rs 945 crore in 9M FY 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY26, which represents 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q4 FY26, CPCL processed 2.93 MMT of crude throughput, operating at 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a distillate yield of 79.1% during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Further, highest ever distillate yield of 79.1%, beating our previous record of 77.6% set in 2019-'20 was also achieved during this year.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL produced 5.139 MMT of diesel and 1.318 MMT of petrol in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL concluded the financial year on a high note, achieving the highest ever production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel HSD, and 1.318 MMT of petrol that is MS, an impressive testament of the refinery's outstanding operational performance.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved LPG production of 447 TMT in FY26 compared to 404 TMT in FY24.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved highest ever LPG production of 447 TMT, overcoming previous record of 404 set in 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a full-year crude throughput of 10.45 MMT in FY25, representing 99.5% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: Q4 FY25 crude throughput reached 2.974 MMT, translating to 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: RLNG consumption increased to 527 TMT in FY25 compared to 441 TMT in FY24.
orders_capacity.quote: RLNG consumption during the year FY 2024-25, was 527 TMT as against 441 TMT in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL processed 64% to 65% of high sulfur crude during FY25.
orders_capacity.quote: During the financial year, we have processed almost 64% - 65% of high sulfur.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved crude throughput of 11,316 TMT in FY 2022-23, 11,642 TMT in FY 2023-24, and 7,480 TMT in 9M FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL's gross borrowings stood at INR 1,900 crores while net borrowings stood at INR 973 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL's debt-equity ratio was 0.39 as of March 31, 2025, with total debt standing at Rs. 3,100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year. At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL's net worth stood at Rs. 7,939 crores as of March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share for FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL is currently structuring the Cauvery Basin Refinery JV with a 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: Presently, we are working with a 2:1 debt equity for this JV.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL reported a net worth of Rs 6,281 crore in FY 2022-23, Rs 8,593 crore in FY 2023-24, and Rs 7,491 crore in 9M FY 2024-25.

risks_headwinds.claim: CPCL recorded foreign exchange losses of approximately INR 200 crores for Q4 FY26 and around INR 350 crores for the full year.
risks_headwinds.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues temporarily impacted 30% to 40% of CPCL's Middle East crude supplies over a short period.
risks_headwinds.quote: What has impacted is that maybe 30% to 40% was affected over a very short period, but all have assured us that depending on the situation, they will make up all the cargoes.

risks_headwinds.claim: CPCL recorded a full-year inventory loss of $0.06 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 40 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: But on an overall annual basis, the inventory would be a loss that is $ 0.06 per barrel, Rs. 40 crores in amount.

risks_headwinds.claim: International HSD product cracks decreased from $13-$15 per barrel to sub-10 levels during FY25.
risks_headwinds.quote: The cracks which were there at about close to $13 to $15 per barrel in HSD and other products has come down to 10 or sub- 10 level in the current year.

risks_headwinds.claim: One crude unit along with the lubes block will undergo maintenance in FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the current financial year 2025-26, one of the other crude units will go for maintenance along with the lubes block as such.

risks_headwinds.claim: CPCL incurred an exchange variation loss of Rs 523 crore in FY 2022-23, Rs 72 crore in FY 2023-24, and Rs 122 crore in 9M FY 2024-25.
Provisions for contingent liabilities were Rs 218 crore in FY 2022-23, Rs 10 crore in FY 2023-24, and Rs 9 crore in 9M FY 2024-25.
CST under-recovery was Rs 463 crore in FY 2022-23, Rs 361 crore in FY 2023-24, and Rs 246 crore in 9M FY 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL will spend INR 2,000 crores across its LOBS project and retail outlet expansion over 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL expects a lot of retail outlet commissioning during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL plans a scheduled Maintenance & Inspection shutdown of one of its refinery units close to September or October.
management_commitments.quote: But yes, maybe close to September, October, we have a scheduled M&I of one of our refinery units.

management_commitments.claim: Normal maintenance CAPEX is projected at around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year for the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

management_commitments.claim: Refinery crude unit 1 catering to lubes will undergo scheduled maintenance around August-September 2025.
management_commitments.quote: In 2025, our refinery crude unit 1 which caters to lubes will go into maintenance around August, September.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
